## Summary

What changed, and why?

## Verification

What evidence did you run or inspect?

## Checklist

- [ ] Scope is narrow and described clearly.
- [ ] Tests/checks were added or updated when meaningful.
- [ ] Existing checks pass for the affected area.
- [ ] Safety Gates are satisfied for high-impact changes.
- [ ] I did not weaken tests/guards just to make CI green.
- [ ] User-facing English/Japanese docs are in sync when applicable.
- [ ] Project Memory changed only if durable knowledge changed.
- [ ] Benchmark/privacy rules are preserved if measurement code changed.
- [ ] Breaking changes are avoided or explicitly documented/reviewed.
